svg.title: NYC Taxi Data Engineering — architecture
svg.desc: TLC files are retrieved locally and published unchanged into RustFS nyc_raw. M2.3 also publishes the pinned reference snapshot under nyc_reference/tlc and immutable provenance under nyc_metadata/tlc. Publication checks remote SHA-256 and full Spark reads. Direct retrieval remains M2.4. The later ingestion job validates once and branches into cleaned Parquet and PostgreSQL for analytics and prediction.
